title: Utillian 5 Wax replacement coils – 2 pack
description:
NO USA SHIPPING, CANADA ONLY

The Utillian 5 replacement coil pack comes in 2 configurations: Triple Titanium or Twisted Kanthal. Both utilize black ceramic and come with 2 replacement coils per pack. These coils are identical to the ones you originally received with your Utillian 5 and should be replaced when you notice the flavor of your vapor degrade.
